notes: Amounts in smallest units (1e6 = $1). Breakdowns and time series returned by the API are identical for chainId 4217 and 8453 at fetch time; per-chain headline numbers that do differ (paidWorkers, activeWallets) are shown per chain. Distinct posters per week are computed from the tasks returned by the paginated /api/tasks list, deduplicated by task id across chains (2179 distinct tasks, 2026-07-05 to 2026-11-27). The list endpoint returns fewer tasks than the breakdown total (2329), so poster figures cover the tasks the list endpoint returns, not every task ever. No names are attached to addresses.
